set.body:
Every Studio workflow run on main after 37394174261 (2026-10-06, success) has failed or been cancelled at the 60-minute limit: 37541014545, 37551379185, 37565443035, 37636586556, 37702698765, 37712977894, 37827826417 (2026-10-08, head a29d6f56).
In 37827826417 the Linux headless job ran the desktop suites until SourceRepairFileFxSuite, whose three tests each failed with java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException after 60 s in StudioFxSuite.runOnFx via FxStage.open (StudioFxSuite.scala:357/243/93). The job then produced no output for ~9 minutes until cancellation, so the FX thread appears to be wedged for every later suite. macOS was cancelled in 'Run functional JavaFX tests'.
Local studio gates pass, so landings have relied on local receipts while the hosted Studio signal has been red for 7 consecutive main pushes.
Acceptance: root cause identified (likely a modal/file dialog or blocking call on the FX thread introduced with source repair); fix plus a harness guard that fails a suite fast and resets the stage instead of wedging the toolkit; Studio workflow green on main on Linux and macOS.
set.title: Hosted Studio CI on main fails since 2026-10-06: SourceRepairFileFxSuite times out in FxStage.open, job cancelled at 60 min
